list.empty: No API token for this entity yet.
list.docsIntro: To write a script, see the integration guide (docs/api/integration.md in the TransTeira repository) and the interactive API documentation.
list.anySender: Any address of the internal domains
list.lastUsedNote: The last use is recorded at most once a minute per token: it may lag behind by up to a minute.

edit.title: Edit the token {name}
edit.intro: The secret of the token does not change. The expiry cannot be changed: create a new token instead.
edit.discardConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Close without saving? They will be lost.

revoke.title: Revoke the token {name}?
revoke.text: Every request made with this token is refused from now on, so the scripts using it stop working. Transfers already created stay available to their recipients. This cannot be undone.

form.title: Token settings

name.label: Name
name.hint: Describes what the token is used for, for example “Nightly ERP export” (100 characters at most).

cidrs.label: Allowed IP ranges
cidrs.hint: One IPv4 or IPv6 range per line, for example 192.0.2.10/32: the addresses the scripts connect from, as seen behind the reverse proxy. Up to 100 ranges.

form.anyAddressWarning: This token can be used from any address. Prefer narrow ranges, or at least set an expiry date.

senders.label: Allowed senders
senders.hint: One email address (reporting@example.com) or domain (example.com) per line. A domain does not cover its subdomains. Up to 100 entries.
senders.empty: With an empty list, the token can deposit as any address of the internal domains of the entity. Restrict it to the addresses the script really uses.

expiry.label: Expiry date (optional)
expiry.hint: The token stops working at the end of this day (your local time). Leave empty for a token that never expires; you can revoke it at any time.

secret.title: Token {name} created
secret.text: Copy this token now and give it to the person in charge of the script through a channel you trust, never by email in clear text.
secret.label: API token
